The proposed solution yields \(C = \frac{992}{2091}\approx0.4745\), which is far below the unavoidable average load \(\frac{2025}{66}\approx30.68\). Since the total mass of the selected balls equals 2025, any feasible bound on the per‑color sum must be at least the average, i.e. at least about 30.7, and in fact the optimal constant is at least \(\lceil2025/66\rceil = 31\). Hence the reasoning and final value in the proposed solution are incorrect.  

**Verdict:** REJECT.
